segments.title: Which desert is the DRIEST on Earth?
segments.say: Which desert is the driest on Earth? Sahara, Atacama, or Gobi? Three. Two. One.

segments.title: A town went 14 YEARS with no rain
segments.say: One town there, Arica, went over fourteen years without a single drop of rain.

segments.title: The Sahara gets WAY more rain
segments.say: The Sahara gets one hundred to two hundred fifty millimeters of rain a year. The Atacama gets just ten to fifteen.

segments.sub: Did you say Sahara? Be honest
